'''Fighters''' are recurring enemies in the ''[[Ninja Gaiden (series)|Ninja Gaiden]]'' series.  They are some of the most common enemies found in many levels. They also come in variants. Some box, some use baseball bats and some throw knives. 
[[File:32988-ninja-gaiden-shadow-game-boy-screenshot-stage-1.gif|thumb|160x160px|A Fighter in Ninja Gaiden Shadow.]]

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:BoxerL.gif|80px]]

Fighters in this game first appear in [[Galesburg|Act 1-1]], and they are exclusively boxers. Normally, they are one of the slowest enemies in the game, even moreso than [[Biker]]s. They move with very short hops to get close to Ryu, and once they do, they will lunge forward with a punch. Although easy to deal with, they can prove to be a nuisance if they keep punching and lunging around in quick bursts. They only deal 1 point of damage on contact, and are easily defeated in one hit by any attack.
